QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (line ~568) sets the global pointers to its own `buffer_alloc_calloc` / `buffer_alloc_free`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the buffer allocator installing itself over the pointers from its init function. It never says it is the only in-tree user of the runtime setter, and it calls it "its own consumer" without exclusivity.
